title: Currency of a Signed Report and Its Refresh, Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services
content:
# Currency of a Signed Report and Its Refresh

**Currency.** A signed report under Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services is treated as current for the months the service sets, counted from the day the report was signed. A report is treated as current only where the handling date has not passed the report's validity in whole calendar months counted from the day the report was signed and issued. Validity months are counted as whole calendar months from the day of signature, and where the anniversary day does not exist in the closing month the boundary falls on the last day of that month. A handling date that falls on the boundary day itself has not passed it, so the report is still current on that day. The day of signature is the issue date on the engagement record, and that record is what the count is taken from; the months the report is treated as current for are fixed per service.

**Refresh or rewrite.** A report still inside its update window is refreshed for the service's update fee rather than rewritten, and a report past that window is prepared afresh at the full fee. The update window and the update fee are fixed per service.

**Acceptance of an expired report.** An expired report is not accepted by the protection desk or the upgrade desk, whatever the value it states, and the customer is offered an update instead.

**Separate lines.** A charge for refreshing a report and a charge for a further copy are each booked to the engagement as their own priced line under their own fee code, so two refreshes of the same report in different periods remain separate entries.

## Calendar cases on a hypothetical validity

Take a service whose report is treated as current for a hypothetical 24 months.

| Report signed | Boundary day | Handling date | Current |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2024 | 15 March 2026 | 15 March 2026 | Yes, the boundary day has not been passed |
| 15 March 2024 | 15 March 2026 | 16 March 2026 | No, the boundary day has been passed |
| 15 March 2024 | 15 March 2026 | 14 March 2026 | Yes |

Where the anniversary day does not exist in the closing month: a report signed on 31 August 2025 under a hypothetical validity of 6 months closes in February 2026, which has no 31st day, so the boundary falls on 28 February 2026. A handling date of 28 February 2026 finds the report current; 1 March 2026 finds it expired.

## Questions answered

**A report is a few days past its boundary but states a value well above what the protection desk needs. Is it accepted?** No. An expired report is not accepted by the protection desk or the upgrade desk, whatever the value it states, and the customer is offered an update instead.

**A report is inside its update window. Is a new report prepared at the full fee?** No. Inside the update window the report is refreshed for the service's update fee rather than rewritten.
